notes.title: New language version - German ...and Spanish, Russian, Chinese - Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9753216/710e962f2f72b5936d74191b44ab5144aabda6b9.jpg

Hi, 
Our game Tsioque is going live tomorrow.  We are pleased to announce that - apart from English and Polish - Tsioque will also premiere featuring a GERMAN language version.

We are also working on Spanish, Russian and Chinese language versions, which should become available shortly after the premiere.
Sincerely,

Ohnoo Studio & Smile
